_doc: Style-guide derived terminology rules for term_lint.py (pgnls ref/style-guide.md R3.1/R3.2/R4.1). A rule fires only when 'en' matches the English source AND 'zh_forbidden' matches the Chinese translation. preserve_terms must appear verbatim in the translation whenever they appear in the source. Keep this list conservative; false positives go to an allowlist with a reason, not here.

rules.note: cluster → 数据库集簇/集簇 (pgdoc rule 121); 集群 only for distributed multi-node systems
cluster must not be rendered as a bare 簇; CLUSTER as an action is 聚簇
connection → 连接, not the old 联接
out of memory → 内存不足
quotes must stay ASCII double quotes (style guide R4.1)

rules.zh_forbidden: 外部数据封装器|外部数据包装程序
rules.note: foreign data wrapper → 外部数据包装器
